claim: Installed grid-scale battery capacity reached 1200 megawatts in the reporting year.
document: Registry entry. Installed grid-scale battery capacity reached 1200 megawatts in the reporting year. Published by the operating agency.
name: exact quote
quote: Installed grid-scale battery capacity reached 1200 megawatts in the reporting year.
rationale: The claim is a verbatim span of the document.

claim: The survey measured household energy use in 2021.
document: National statistics release. The survey measured household energy use in 2021. Sample size and method are documented in the accompanying methodology note.
name: verbatim sentence, no quote field
rationale: Claim appears verbatim; token coverage is complete even though no quote is supplied.

claim: Battery capacity degrades by 42% per year in all climates.
document: Capacity degradation is about 2% per year for cells held at moderate temperature, with degradation increasing at higher temperature.
name: fabricated percentage
rationale: The document never states 42%. This is the central failure mode the verifier must block.

claim: The dataset was published in 1998.
document: The dataset was published in 2019. It covers the period from the previous decade.
name: wrong year
rationale: The claim asserts a date the document contradicts and does not contain.

claim: Grid-scale storage deployment doubled during the period examined, driven mainly by falling cell prices.
document: Battery cell prices fell sharply over the decade, and deployment of grid-scale storage grew steadily across the period.
name: partial overlap, defensible reading
rationale: The subject matches but the document does not state doubling, nor that prices were the main driver.

claim: The reported share of renewable generation is 12 percent.
document: The reported share of renewable generation is 12% for the period covered by this release.
name: percent formatting difference
rationale: Same number written differently; percentage canonicalisation must treat these as equal.

claim: Installed capacity reached 1200 megawatts.
document: Installed capacity reached 1,200 megawatts at the end of the period.
name: thousands separator difference
rationale: Comma formatting must not create a false mismatch.

claim: The agency reports that emissions from electricity generation declined over the period.
document: Emissions from electricity generation declined over the period, according to the agency that publishes the annual inventory.
name: paraphrase with full token overlap
rationale: Every content token of the claim appears in the document; the wording order differs.

claim: The regulator approved the standard.
name: empty document
rationale: Nothing can be verified against an empty document.

document: The regulator approved the standard in the reporting year, subject to annual review.
name: empty claim
rationale: An empty claim asserts nothing.

claim: The pilot reduced cost by 30 percent and the procedure is repeatable.
document: The pilot ran for eight weeks. The procedure is repeatable.
name: number added to a true quote
rationale: The quoted part is genuine but the claim attaches an unsupported figure to it. Hard failure must win over the quote.

claim: The protein fold was determined by cryogenic electron microscopy.
document: The turbine was commissioned in the reporting year and has a rated output of four megawatts.
name: unrelated subject
rationale: No shared subject matter; the document cannot support the claim.

claim: In 2021 the indicator was 5.
document: Indicator series, annual. In 2021 the indicator was 5.
name: matching date and value
rationale: Full token and numeric agreement.

claim: The intervention reduced infection rates in the treated group.
document: The intervention did not reduce infection rates in the treated group; the difference was within noise.
name: negation flipped by the document
rationale: Token overlap is high but the document negates the claim. Polarity detection must catch this.

claim: The treatment did not improve survival in the trial arm.
document: The treatment improved survival in the trial arm by a clear margin.
name: negation in the claim only
rationale: Polarity differs in the other direction; accepting this would invert the source.

claim: This is the same as that.
document: This is the same as that, according to the report.
name: claim with no content words
rationale: A claim with no discriminating content cannot be supported by any document.

claim: Annual generation from the technology rose across the decade.
document: In the national accounts, annual generation from the technology rose across the decade while installed capacity changed little.
name: quoted sub-span of a long sentence
quote: generation from the technology rose across the decade
rationale: The quote is a genuine sub-span, which is stronger evidence than a token score.

claim: The programme cut operating expenditure substantially across all regions.
document: The programme reported lower operating expenditure in most regions, with the largest falls in the north.
name: short non-verbatim quote with middling overlap
rationale: The short quote is below the minimum quotable length, and the claim overstates the scope, so only partial support is warranted.

claim: The report states "a marked improvement" in reliability.
document: The report states “a marked improvement” in reliability, noting the measurement caveat.
name: unicode typography difference
rationale: Curly quotes and straight quotes must normalise to the same text.

claim: The plant produced 450 gigawatt hours in 2022 from 3 units at 150 megawatts each.
document: Operating summary for 2022: the plant produced 450 gigawatt hours from 3 units, each rated at 150 megawatts.
name: three numbers all present
rationale: Every figure in the claim appears in the document.

claim: The plant produced 450 gigawatt hours in 2022 from 4 units at 150 megawatts each.
document: Operating summary for 2022: the plant produced 450 gigawatt hours from 3 units, each rated at 150 megawatts.
name: one of three numbers missing
rationale: A single substituted figure must fail the whole claim.

claim: The standard took effect in 2025.
document: The standard took effect in 2024 after a consultation period.
name: year off by one
rationale: Temporal precision matters; a wrong year is a wrong claim.

claim: The cost fell to 50 dollars per kilowatt hour.
document: The cost fell to 50 euros per kilowatt hour by the end of the period.
exclusion_reason: The verifier compares numeric literals, not unit words, so a currency substitution is not a hard failure. The case is kept in the set so the limitation stays visible, and it is excluded from the threshold selection objective so that it cannot be hidden by tuning.
name: unit substitution not detected
rationale: KNOWN LIMITATION: the verifier compares numeric literals, not unit words, so a currency substitution is not a hard failure. It is reported as needing review, and the limitation is published on the site.

claim: Many factors are involved and more research is needed in this area.
document: Many factors are involved and more research is needed in this area, the authors conclude.
name: generic filler sentence
rationale: The sentence is verbatim, so verification is correct to accept it. What must exclude it is the admission rule in the grounding stage (minimum content tokens), which the test suite checks separately. This case pins the separation between 'is it supported?' and 'is it worth storing?'.

claim: Emissions from the sector rose by 4% over the period.
document: Sectoral review. Emissions from the sector fell by 4% over the period, according to the operating agency.
name: direction of change reversed
rationale: The number matches but the claim's direction of change is the opposite of the passage; the verifier caps it for review rather than publishing it as supported.

claim: The method works in all conditions tested by the laboratory.
document: Laboratory note. The method worked in about a third of the conditions tested, according to the laboratory.
name: universal claim against a hedged passage
rationale: The claim is stated as universal while the passage hedges with 'about'; the verifier caps it for review.
